text: hm. i click apply + show all and it doesnt do anything now
resolution: Diagnosed the inert Apply + Show All button from live evidence: local triangle baking succeeded, but the generic asynchronous file-picker layer route never installed its staged PNG and swallowed the outcome. Replaced that hop with a dedicated synchronous pixel bridge that content-addresses the encoded patch directly into the model UV workspace and returns exact refusals to the UI. The user confirmed the repaired button works; patch tests 3/3 and the editor bundle check pass. Removed seven orphaned temporary PNGs created only by the failed route.
